<role>

</role>
<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked whether the problem 'Claim progress notifications are sent manually, causing delays and reliance on workarounds' is already solved or covered. The Notion page 'Policyholder milestone notifications' describes Keelwater automatically notifying policyholders at key claims milestones (document submission completion, adjuster assignment, payout approval) without manual status checks — this is the same core problem of automating claim progress notifications, and it appears as a roadmap/product page covering it. The other items (Claims timeline, Supplier directory, bulk upload, supplier address fields) address different problems. Since a roadmap item already covers the core problem, the opportunity is a duplicate.", "verdict": "fail"}
